panels.title: p95 pool checkout wait
panels.description: Time to get a connection from the pool. Not part of command latency: a saturated pool shows up here first.

panels.title: Errors / s by category
panels.description: timeout, network, server or client. Network errors and timeouts point at the path to the server; server errors at the request.

panels.title: Errors / s by command and error type
Retries / s by command
panels.description: Commands the driver retried after a retryable error. The application saw only the retry's outcome.

panels.title: Pool checkout failures / s
panels.description: timeout means the pool was exhausted for longer than WaitQueueTimeout.

panels.title: Connections in use vs pool size
Pool clears
panels.description: The driver clears a pool after a network error or when the server becomes unusable.

panels.title: Server selection p95 by operation
panels.description: Time spent finding a suitable server. Spikes during elections or when no primary is reachable.

panels.title: Server type changes
panels.description: Elections, step-downs and outages: a server becoming primary, secondary or unknown.

panels.title: Cursor closes / s by reason
panels.description: exhausted and killed are normal. abandoned means the application leaked a cursor; server_expired that the server reaped one the application was still reading.

panels.title: Leaked and expired cursors by collection
Connections opened / s
panels.description: Steady churn means connections are being dropped and re-established.

panels.title: Instrumentation problems
panels.description: Label overflow: more distinct (database, collection) pairs than MaxCollectionLabels; they are recorded as __other__.
